_readme: Weapons and armor (from the Equipment Stats tab of the design sheet). A unit's stats = (level stats + Body + every piece's base stats x its quality's baseMultiplier) x every piece's modifiers. Modifiers multiply (1.2 = 120%; missing = 100%), except pPenPct / mPenPct, which add whole percents of penetration. Weapon skills: the first is the basic attack, the second the class skill; range is the weapon's range in tiles (its Basic Attack's, and the bow's shots). art is the pose and weapon drawn on figures, outfit the armor drawn (src/art/unitArt.js). builtIn entries are what a unit has with nothing equipped (Unarmed, No Armor): they aren't items.

smithy._comment: The Smithy (Outer City): buys Common gear on the spot (buyQuality), and takes orders for better quality, paid up front: each quality in orderDays takes that many days of work. It works on up to workers orders at a time; the rest wait in the queue. Prices are the qualities' values.

enemyGear._comment: Enemies whose gear quality is crude get Common gear instead with this chance per level (0.03 = 3% per level, so 30% at level 10).

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Magic focus with reach. Pairs with Mage skills.

crystal.name: Crystal
crystal.description: A focusing crystal: its magic cuts through Defense.

sword_shield.name: Sword and Shield
sword_shield.description: Frontline weapon. The shield adds Defense.

mace_shield.name: Mace and Shield
mace_shield.description: The mace crushes through armor; the shield adds Defense.

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.description:
Long-ranged bow with three modes:
• Direct: 100% P.Atk, weapon range
• Indirect: 70% P.Atk, 1.5x range,
   arcs over cover
• Melee: 80% P.Atk, 1.5 tiles
Switch Mode is a free action.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description:
Light bow: shorter range, but you move faster.
Modes as the Longbow (Direct, Indirect, Melee).

dagger.name: Single Dagger
dagger.description: Quick blade that slips past armor.

twin_daggers.name: Twin Daggers
twin_daggers.description: A blade in each hand that slips past armor.

unarmed.name: Unarmed
unarmed.description: Fists. What you fight with without a weapon.

mail.name: Mail
mail.description: Sturdier, but slows you down a little.

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: The toughest armor, and the heaviest.
